* Replace old Prisma symbol with presskit logo mark in Studio nav

The navigation logo still used the old monochrome Prisma symbol. Swap
both the light-mode mark and the dark-mode white symbol to the current
logo mark from the prisma/presskit assets (background rect and clip
removed so the mark stays transparent on themed surfaces).

Closes PRS-706

Co-Authored-By: Gremlin <gremlin[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

* Resize replaced logo SVGs to their original dimensions

The presskit artwork was dropped in at its native 263x264 canvas, so
both logo files declared an intrinsic size far larger than the assets
they replaced (12x14 and 58x72). Keep the new mark but restore the
original width/height and scale it via the viewBox so the nav logo
renders at the same size as before.

Closes PRS-706

Co-Authored-By: Gremlin <gremlin[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

Update Prisma nav logo to current presskit logo mark (#1586)

* Replace old Prisma symbol with presskit logo mark in Studio nav

The navigation logo still used the old monochrome Prisma symbol. Swap
both the light-mode mark and the dark-mode white symbol to the current
logo mark from the prisma/presskit assets (background rect and clip
removed so the mark stays transparent on themed surfaces).

Closes PRS-706

Co-Authored-By: Gremlin <gremlin[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

* Resize replaced logo SVGs to their original dimensions

The presskit artwork was dropped in at its native 263x264 canvas, so
both logo files declared an intrinsic size far larger than the assets
they replaced (12x14 and 58x72). Keep the new mark but restore the
original width/height and scale it via the viewBox so the nav logo
renders at the same size as before.

Closes PRS-706

Co-Authored-By: Gremlin <gremlin[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
